verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a fully-featured CLI for managing the vault and a personal API key for CLI authentication that it calls suitable for automated workflows. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs keylessly from npm and offers a `bw serve` local REST mode, and a community member describes hands-on headless CLI use. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration documentation (e.g., CI runner recipes or an official action) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
the official bw CLI installs keylessly from npm (@bitwarden/cli, registry latest 2026.8.0) and prints its version
